- [RCTS.1.2.22] **`witnesses`** (optional) — an array of strings, each
  `<path>#<name>`: a `checks` entry with role `witness`, on a clause the
  fixture links, whose scenario the fixture's steps and expectation are
  ([STYL.5.3.6.4]). A harness does not read it, and it does not decide
  whether the fixture passes.
